clauses.why: Scheduling imports for a later time is a new capability; immediate bulk creation fully satisfies the request.
Slack notifications are an integration the request never calls for; the upload works without them.
A usage dashboard charting weekly imports is unrelated to creating users from a CSV.
A five-week welcome email course is an onboarding feature beyond bulk user creation.
Names 'appropriate limits' without stating any limit or what happens when one is exceeded.
'User-friendly' error handling gives no specific behaviour a builder could act on or test.
Accepting a 6,000-row file contradicts C-9, which refuses any file over 5,000 rows.
Aborting the whole import on one invalid row contradicts C-7, which processes rows independently.
